products.name: Talens Art Creation Acrylic Paint, 12 mL, Assorted Colors, Set Of 24 Tubes
products.category: ['Office Supplies ~ Art & Crafting ~ Painting ~ Acrylic & Tempera Paints']
products.description: Create your masterpiece with Talens Art Creation Acrylic Paint. Use each hue straight out of the tube or thin it with water to achieve the ideal consistency for your work of art. Designed for canvas, wood panels and other moderately absorbent grounds. Contains 100% acrylic resin-based paint. Vibrant pigment brings your artwork to life. Water-soluble formula lets you clean up without using chemicals. Paint is waterproof once completely dry. Set includes 24 tubes in an assortment of colors.
